Nashama TV iOS v1.1.11:
- Fixed Favorites: tapping a saved movie or series did nothing; now opens its detail page. Tapping a saved live channel now plays it directly from the Favorites tab.
- Moved the remove (trash) icon onto the poster image itself so it no longer competes for space with the pin icon.
- v1.1.10 fix carried forward: live/movie/episode playback stability restored.
- Install with Sideloadly or xtool using your Apple ID; re-sideload every 7 days to keep it signed.
